data.title: Phase 3: Five Multi-Agent Pilot Workflows — Proof of Concept at Scale
data.subtitle: Five production-grade agentic workflows deployed in live Unilever procurement operations with measured outcomes against baseline

workflows.title: Volume Collection Agent
workflows.desc: Pulls forward volumes from markets and converts FG/BOM data into raw material demand, with QC and gap resolution
workflows.in: In: FG volumes, BOM data, market forecasts
workflows.out: Out: Cleansed RM demand signal, gap flags

workflows.title: Autonomous Sourcing & Negotiation Agent
workflows.desc: Runs low-to-medium value sourcing end-to-end — supplier selection, rate cards, negotiation, contract creation
workflows.in: In: Spend data, supplier list, spec sheets
workflows.out: Out: Executed contracts, rate cards, audit trail

workflows.title: Bid Analysis & Technical Evaluation Agent
workflows.desc: Parses bid responses, normalizes commercial terms, evaluates technical specifications, produces comparative analysis

workflows.title: Cost Modeling Agent
workflows.desc: Builds should-cost models, decomposes cost drivers, benchmarks against markets, monitors PPV against forecast
workflows.in: In: Cost data, market indices, BOM

workflows.title: Contract Obligation Management Agent
workflows.desc: Tracks post-contract obligations, KPIs, rebates, value leakage, and supplier compliance against negotiated terms
workflows.in: In: Contract terms, supplier KPIs, invoice data
